objects.name: base
objects.prompt:
Pixel art ultimate professional developer desk setup, front view, straight-on camera angle. A large premium modern desk with three high-end monitors arranged side by side, one centered and two on the sides. A Mac Studio clearly visible on the desk, premium mechanical keyboard, mouse, professional speakers, monitor arms, excellent cable management and subtle high-end desk accessories. Powerful, sophisticated workstation for an elite software developer, clean and luxurious without looking futuristic.

Centered composition, full desk visible from the front, isolated object, detailed retro pixel art, consistent proportions and scale with the previous desk setups, transparent background.

IMPORTANT: NO CHAIR, NO STOOL, NO SEATING, NO PERSON. Only the desk and computer equipment.

La progresión quedaría muy clara visualmente: basura/improvisado → developer normal → workstation pro. Para tu juego, mantendría además el mismo ancho aproximado del sprite en los tres, aunque el tercero puede ser un poco más ancho por los 3 monitores.
